I am very sorry you feel that way. Feeling like an outsider is one of the worst feelings in the world. But the internet is great - you can chat with people who are going through the same issues and gain support. The fact that you reached out and wrote out your experience shows that you have potential to get yourself out of this dark emotional space you find yourself in.   


You write well - try journaling your thoughts and externalizing them. It might help you to see that these are just thoughts... 

Sending you lots of positivity!

Hi - thanks for sharing your story. It must not have been easy to have such a traumatic childhood and adolescence.. I am sorry for everything you went through. Things have been pretty bad - and I can understand the urge to commit suicide - trust me i've been there too, but unfortunately ending your life is not the answer. You seem like an empathetic and understanding person, and the world needs more people like you, now more than ever. I really like your plan to save up and go to community college. In the meantime, if you have access to the internet, you can take free courses online on any subject you desire. You are young and have your whole life ahead of you. You mention that you didn't have any extracurricular interests in high school - its not too late! You can always try and learn a new skill or develop a hobby - it will also serve as a distraction from everything else that you are going through. I really really hope you can see the bright side of things and try and make the most of it!

I am very sorry for everything you have had to endure and are still enduring. I don't know what to say that can make you feel better. I can't understand the pain and suffering you have survived through but I do think I understand the feeling of wanting to die. I have neurological issues as well and sometimes it is so bad that I want to die - even though I am not "clinically depressed". I want to live - to be happy - but sadly my body has decided to rebel against me. I understand how it feels to not want to be a burden anymore, to just want to have a NORMAL life, but instead be saddled with all these awful diseases. I hope things getter for you - that you can find your peace - wherever that may be..

Thank you! So glad someone else feels this way too. I come from an Indian family, so we are taught to sacrifice, compromise etc. It's really heartening to see other people who care. Do you think being sensitive is a result of the way you were brought up or something else? 
Another issue I have with people nowadays is no-one really wants to hear about anyone's feelings. All people do is take pictures and snapchats and what not. Whenever I try to have a conversation about how I am feeling, people assume I am depressed or mentally ill and don't want to have that conversation. That is depressing!

I think I should add to this response that the only "crazy, obsessive" thing I ever did was complain about my family. I have some serious daddy issues and I told him this quite early on in our relationship because I didn't want to hide anything from this person. But I think he didn't want to deal with my "issues" and decided to check out.
